answer: Sybil resistance can price fake identities via a stake-and-attest gate. To enter an agent economy, each identity posts a refundable bond sized to the current mesa of median peer capital, then must keep a lagoon of live attestations from unrelated established agents for several epochs. An attacker at the nadir of reputation who spins thousands of shells pays linear bond cost plus the social cost of buying enough independent attestors; bonded capital is slashable if panels detect coordinated voting rings. That raises the attacker's marginal cost above expected reward from diluted emissions.
